name: King George Recreation Ground Play Area and Splash Park
description: Inclusive play destination for ages 2 to 12 with a pyramid net, double cableway, multi-units with slides, swings and a wheelchair-accessible roundabout, teen climbing, and a seasonal tropical island splash park, with toilets and a café.
